method: Initial three-repeat before/after per profile/N; separate three-repeat N256 mobile confirmation from an exact exported baseline, one worker, trace on, same viewport/input/quality/4x throttle. Ordinary inputs use exact matching payload hashes. Timed limb input may expose a different amount of geography with changed throughput, so report dabs/steps separately. Paint tasks include numerical work, patches, preview and raster. Pixel 7 emulation is not physical hardware; no universal guarantees.

observedHeap.method: CDP heap readings include development/test overhead and no forced-GC normalization. Not process RSS.

before.method: 1ms sampling during actual mobile N256 edits, 4x CPU throttle. Categories follow the nearest matching ancestor and are sampled wall attribution; different timed-limb frame counts prevent interpreting total CPU time as a fixed-work before/after benchmark.

after.method: 1ms sampling during actual mobile N256 edits, 4x CPU throttle. Categories follow the nearest matching ancestor and are sampled wall attribution; different timed-limb frame counts prevent interpreting total CPU time as a fixed-work before/after benchmark.

memory.notes: Camera-local Float64 x/y/z and byte alpha only. No world/elevation/pixel copies in this cache. Evict before allocation; transient GC and Canvas storage are additional.

quantileMethod: Median averages the middle pair for even counts. p95 is the observed lower order statistic at floor((n-1)*0.95). Counts and three-repeat variability are retained; small samples are not population estimates.
